accepted_sample.concept: ST-elevation myocardial infarction – diagnosis and urgent reperfusion
accepted_sample.note: Diagnostic STEMI presentation and urgent reperfusion decision are single-best-answer and do not depend on troponin positivity.

accepted_sample.concept: Atrial fibrillation – Initial anticoagulation in new-onset AF
accepted_sample.note: NICE NG196 1.8.8 supports heparin at initial presentation until stroke/bleeding risk assessment and appropriate therapy are established.
Mechanical-valve anticoagulation in pregnancy is specialist/individualised; the item avoids the unsafe claim that warfarin is absolutely contraindicated in every pregnancy.
The stem explicitly establishes persistent room-air saturation 89% in a 4-month-old without high-risk comorbidity; NICE NG9 uses persistent <90% for oxygen in children aged 6 weeks and over.

accepted_sample.concept: Ovarian cancer – CA125 is interpreted with age-specific thresholds
accepted_sample.note: Current NICE NG12 (2026) uses an urgent ultrasound threshold of CA125 >=25 IU/mL for age 70–79; 26 IU/mL is correctly above the threshold.
The keyed principle—NEWS2 together with clinical judgement for non-pregnant adults in acute hospital settings—is aligned with NICE NG253.

false_positive_passes.concept: Atrial fibrillation – Long-term stroke prevention anticoagulants
false_positive_passes.defect: Explanation explicitly assigns CHA2DS2-VASc component points and gives a generated total of 3 despite the evidence contract requiring raw components without generated score arithmetic. This is a PASS-precision failure even though the resulting anticoagulation decision happens to be clinically concordant.

Explanation explicitly counts 'two CURB-65 criteria' and maps the generated count to a category despite the packet forbidding precomputed totals/counts. The reviewer false-passed a direct contract violation.

rejected_sample.genuine_defect: Competing reperfusion/angiography options can remain defensible because timing and downstream strategy are not fully separated by the verified packet.

rejected_sample.concept: ACS with a separate indication for anticoagulation – antiplatelet strategy
rejected_sample.genuine_defect: Concrete fixed-duration triple-therapy distractors conflict with a packet whose tested principle is individualisation and can become independently defensible.

rejected_sample.concept: Varicella exposure in pregnancy – post-exposure prophylaxis
rejected_sample.genuine_defect: Timing decision is not reproducible unless the first day of exposure is explicitly anchored; later attempt also showed option-length cueing.
Hypertonic saline and mannitol are both packet-supported immediate treatments, so selecting one without an availability/context discriminator creates two defensible answers.

rejected_sample.concept: Endometrial cancer – current NICE referral criteria
rejected_sample.genuine_defect: HRT modifier appears despite the hardened packet requiring this target to omit HRT rather than infer non-attribution.

rejected_sample.concept: Sepsis – early management is risk- and population-specific
rejected_sample.genuine_defect: Generated NEWS2 arithmetic/risk category is not reproducible from raw observations in multiple attempts, making the keyed antibiotic timing wrong or unsupported.

highest_leverage_defect: Automated PASS precision remains unsafe for generated named-score arithmetic: prompt-only arithmetic instructions and the prior deterministic exemption for score-focused concepts allow direct evidence-contract violations to pass.
fix_applied: Added run-37 generation instructions forbidding any generated named-score totals, point assignments, or counted criteria, plus a deterministic fail-closed DERIVED_SCORE_ARITHMETIC guard that applies even to score-focused concepts. Reviewer and all existing safety/ambiguity/source gates remain unchanged or stricter.
next_eval: Triggered automatically from the launch-eval-100 branch after the run-37 guard commits; evaluate PASS precision before optimising overall pass rate.
